dct_creator_sm: McFaul, Emily (Department of Plant Agriculture. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: As part of the "Management of Stemphylium leaf blight" thesis research, evaluation of leaf dieback for five onion cultivars, after exposure to three S. vesicarium toxin filtrate treatments, was conducted. Additional data from preliminary studies to develop methods used for cultivar sensitivity evaluations were also included.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Management of Stemphylium leaf blight: Onion cultivar sensitivity to S. vesicarium toxins.
